summary: Sea Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 20, 2026, attaching Exhibit 99.1, an email from Chairman and CEO Forrest Li to all employees marking the ninth anniversary of the company's October 20, 2017 NYSE IPO. The filing contains no transaction terms, no stake, price, premium or timetable, and no board recommendation or named advisor; it is a commemorative management communication accompanied by standard forward-looking-statement language and the customary signature block. No structural or regulatory mechanics are implicated. Nothing here alters the capital structure or ownership; there is no risk-arb angle to monitor.
